uncited: *   **Text Prompt Accuracy:** Text-based editing relies heavily on the IP2P model.
*   **Opacity Issues:** High opacity causes occlusion, leaving uncovered primitives unedited.
Low opacity leads to blurry stylization due to inconsistent IP2P edits across views.
*   **Time Complexity:** The method requires iterative optimization.
Image-driven NPSE takes approximately 3,000 iterations, while text-driven NPSE takes 1,500 iterations.
TexGS-VolVis is the first 2DGS-based framework in VolVis aimed at expressive scene editing.
It builds upon existing NeRF and 3DGS scene editing approaches [6, 7, 9, 22] guided by text instructions.
